summary:
## Project Overview
2D Godot arcade/shooter project using node-based scene composition and singleton-style global managers. The main entry point was not directly inspected, but `GameManager` is referenced as a root-level node/autoload, suggesting it coordinates global game state.

## System Modules
| Module | Responsibility | Key Files | Key Functions/Signals |
|--------|---------------|-----------|----------------------|
| Bullet | Projectile behavior, collision detection, and visuals (targeted for glow-trail effect) | `res://scripts/bullet.gd`, `res://scenes/bullet.tscn` | `extends Area2D`; `static func _gm()`; `static func _am()` |
| Game Manager | Global game state/control, referenced by Bullet | Inferred root-level node `"GameManager"` | Accessed via `Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_node_or_null("GameManager")` |
| Audio Manager | Global audio control, referenced by Bullet | Inferred root-level node `"AudioManager"` | Accessed via `Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_node_or_null("AudioManager")` |

## Dependencies & Signal Flow
- `res://scripts/bullet.gd` depends on `GameManager` and `AudioManager`, resolving them at runtime through `Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_node_or_null("<Name>")`. This pattern implies both managers are root-level singletons, likely autoloads.
- `res://scenes/bullet.tscn` is an `Area2D` with two child nodes; one child name was truncated to `"Co..."` during inspection, so its exact type and purpose could not be fully verified.
- No signal connections, exported properties, or collision callbacks were fully confirmed from the explored snippets.

## Issues Found
- `screenshot_editor` failed because `EditorInterface` is unavailable in the current execution context, blocking in-editor visual verification of the glow-trail changes.
- Only `res://scripts/bullet.gd` and `res://scenes/bullet.tscn` were explored; the implementations of `GameManager` and `AudioManager` and the actual signal wiring remain unverified.
- Scene inspection returned a truncated child name (`"Co..."`), leaving the precise second child node type unresolved.
